communication_goal: 说明延期原因、讨论范围并确认下一步。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers discussing a project at a desk. An upright spiral-bound desk CALENDAR with a large clean seven-column grid of empty square date cells stands on the RIGHT side of the desk, fully visible and not overlapping either hand. Developer left gestures apologetically; team lead center gestures calmly toward calendar. Laptop is secondary. Calendar has no numerals, letters or marked dates.

coverage_review.scope: W025 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W025.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：纯黑背景白色火柴人线稿，单幅双人工作沟通场景、底图无文字；有装订与日期格的完整桌面日历可定位。 其余3词仅以明确对白支持，不虚构局部框。 局部裁剪复查后扩大右/下边界，保护完整道具。
